text: What happens to me during a marathon?

steps.title: Heart and blood flow
steps.say: Your heart climbs to around 187 beats a minute and sends most of your blood to your leg muscles. Your gut gets very little, so the pizza barely moves.

steps.title: Fuel runs low
steps.say: Your liver's sugar store drops almost to empty after two hours. That is the wall runners talk about, and you may feel heavy and drained.

steps.title: Heat and water loss
steps.say: Your body heats to about 38.6 °C and you sweat away over 3 litres of fluid. You would need to keep drinking.

lines.text: In the model, a four-hour run starting now pushes your heart to about 187 beats a minute.
By 23:10 your liver's sugar store is nearly empty and your body is about 38.6 °C.
You may feel drained and thirsty. Pizza and beer still in your stomach would slow you.
